summary.text: Keith Varian, a write-in, no-party-affiliation candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Florida's 14th Congressional District to Kathy Castor.
He describes himself as a construction worker and political outsider who ran against career politicians.

paragraphs.text: Varian was born in Albany, New York. He earned a high school diploma from Columbia High School and attended Hudson Valley Community College, and he works in construction.
He lost to Kathy Castor, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
